fields.name: autoformat_stackdriver_trace
fields.description: Rewrite the trace field to include the projectID and format it for use with Cloud Trace. When this flag is enabled, the user can get the correct result by printing only the traceID (usually 32 characters).

fields.name: cloud_logging_base_url
fields.description: Set the base Cloud Logging API URL to use for the /v2/entries:write API request.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism. The only available option is gzip. If no value is specified, no compression is applied.

fields.name: custom_k8s_regex
fields.description: Set a custom regular expression to extract fields like pod_name, namespace_name, container_name, and docker_id from the local_resource_id in logs. This is helpful if the value of pod or node name contains dots.

fields.name: export_to_project_id
fields.description: The GCP project that should receive these logs.
fields.default: The project_id in the google_service_credentials file, or the project_id from Google's metadata.google.internal server.

fields.name: google_service_credentials
fields.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud credentials JSON file.

fields.name: http_request_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the LogEntry's httpRequest. The default matches records that use logging.googleapis.com/http_request (underscore form). Set this to logging.googleapis.com/httpRequest when the record uses the httpRequest key form expected by the Logging API.

fields.name: job
fields.description: An identifier for a grouping of related tasks, such as the name of a microservice or distributed batch. If the resource type is generic_task, this field is required.

fields.name: k8s_cluster_location
fields.description: The physical location of the cluster that contains (node or pod based on the resource type) the container. If the resource type is k8s_container, k8s_node, or k8s_pod, this field is required.

fields.name: k8s_cluster_name
fields.description: The name of the cluster that the container (node or pod based on the resource type) is running in. If the resource type is k8s_container, k8s_node, or k8s_pod, this field is required.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Optional list of comma-separated strings specifying key=value pairs. The resulting labels will be combined with the elements obtained from labels_key to set the LogEntry Labels. Elements from labels will override duplicate values from labels_key.

fields.name: labels_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the LogEntry's labels.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The GCP or AWS region in which to store data about the resource. If the resource type is either generic_node or generic_task, this field is required.

fields.name: log_name_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the logName value.

fields.name: metadata_server
fields.description: Prefix for a metadata server.
fields.default: Value of environment variable $METADATA_SERVER, or http://metadata.google.internal if unset.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: A namespace identifier, such as a cluster name or environment. If the resource type is either generic_node or generic_task, this field is required.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the node within the namespace, such as a hostname or IP address. If the resource type is generic_node, this field is required.

fields.name: project_id_key
fields.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to find the GCP projectID from jsonPayload and then extract the value of it to set the PROJECT_ID within LogEntry logName, which controls the GCP project that should receive these logs.
fields.default: logging.googleapis.com/projectId. See Stackdriver Special Fields for more info.

fields.name: resource
fields.description: Set resource type of data. Supported resource types: k8s_container, k8s_node, k8s_pod, global, generic_node, generic_task, and gce_instance.

fields.name: resource_labels
fields.description: An optional list of comma-separated strings specifying resource label plain text assignments (new=value) and mappings from an original field in the log entry to a destination field (destination=$original). Nested fields and environment variables are also supported using the record accessor syntax. If configured, all resource labels will be assigned using this API only, with the exception of project_id. See Resource Labels for more details.

fields.name: service_account_email
fields.description: Account email associated with the service. Only available if no credentials file has been provided.

fields.name: service_account_secret
fields.description: Private key content associated with the service account. Only available if no credentials file has been provided.

fields.name: severity_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the severity.

fields.name: span_id_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the span ID.

fields.name: tag_prefix
fields.description: Set the tag_prefix used to validate the tag of logs with Kubernetes resource type. Without this option, the tag of the log must be in format of k8s_container(pod/node).* to use the k8s_container resource type. Now the tag prefix is configurable by this option (note the ending dot).

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the task within the namespace and job, such as a replica index identifying the task within the job. If the resource type is generic_task, this field is required.

fields.name: text_payload_key
fields.description: Set the key from the record to use as the textPayload field in the log entry.

fields.name: trace_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the trace value.

fields.name: trace_sampled_key
fields.description: The name of the key from the original record that contains the trace sampled flag.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
